findings.title: Unpinned non-UTF8 output suppresses the established artifact-mismatch report
spec_basis: design-v1.md validation order 2/6: pin equality before trusting contents
docs/public-capture-binding.md: artifacts must match SHA/count before trusted; mismatch wins unknown
findings.reproduction: Preserve a valid binding/transport pin and output SHA/count, overwrite only text.txt with b"\xff". Control is an equally unpinned valid UTF8 tamper.
findings.observed: UTF8 tamper returns mismatch/extracted_text_sha_mismatch. NonUTF8 tamper raises ValueError Native saved extraction must be valid UTF-8; CLIexit2/stdout absent loses the structured known-mismatch report.
findings.impact: Audit result classification and diagnostics differ according to bytes that failed the pin. No false matched result or financial adoption was observed.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate/decode output UTF8 only after output_check.status==matched. Otherwise keep trusted_output=None and preserve artifact mismatch with unknown content checks. Pinned nonUTF8 remains a ValueError.
findings.coverage_gap: Existing UTF8 test pins nonUTF8 and correctly expects error; transport-tamper test checks pin-before-parse but no corresponding mismatched-output nonUTF8 case.

findings.title: Unsupported profile bypasses native-v1 shared implementation validation
spec_basis: docs/public-capture-binding.md implementation name/version/nullable SHA and malformed schema ValueError
findings.reproduction: Use pinned v1 artifacts; set extraction.implementation=[] with an unknown profile name. Second case uses known plain profile/version2 and implementation={name:"",version:3,sha256:"not-SHA"}. Re-pin transport to those intentionally malformed records.
findings.observed: Known profile+implementation=[] rejects. Unknown name and unsupported version both return normal unknown/all_declared_bindings_agree:null; required common implementation validation is skipped.
findings.impact: A recognized native-v1 record with malformed common schema can be accepted as completed unknown merely by unsupported profile selection. It is not promoted to matched or implementation-verified.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate implementation exact keys, nonempty name/version and nullable SHA before unsupported profile dispatch. Continue to leave unsupported profile-specific parameter meaning unknown and do not replay an extractor.
findings.coverage_gap: Existing unknown profile/version tests retain valid implementation, while known-schema tests do not combine invalid shared implementation with unsupported profiles.

other_reviewed_boundaries.result: No defect: raw:null is absent from the frozen nullable list. Its rejection agrees with schema. A failed capture with nonnull raw and no extraction returns mismatch.
Source-ID derivation, implementation identity, raw-to-output replay, citations, authenticity, financial meaning, current GET permission and DBfirstsave remain explicitly not_performed.

Read strict RFC6901 index/escape/empty-root handling, missing node unknown and within-case legacy path checks; new tests cover duplicate/nonfinite sibling JSON and escape targets. No new filesystem race or broad fuzz review.
Aware instants, status/complete/error, source retrieval=body completion and Content-Length versus actual entity bytes are separated. Caller declarations are not historical authenticity.
All independent calls omitted synthetic secret URL/error values; per-audit full fixture hashes were unchanged. Network, sqlite connect and extraction-tool entrypoints were guarded.

legacy_compatibility.report_metadata_not_equated: After examples contain an additional exact_before_report_equal flag; report/bundle/id values were compared explicitly.

limits: No false matched result was found in these discrepancies.
Failure raw:null is not in the frozen v1 nullable list, so its rejection is a control, not a reported bug.
The audit is an internal declaration check, not authenticity, extraction replay, historical occurrence or financial certification.
Bounded native-binding review and one synthetic fixture; not a broad fuzz/performance/restore/authentication audit.
Findings affect validation/result semantics; no false matched result was reproduced.
Production fixes are left to parent/producer and all v1 source/design artifacts are preserved.
